Results.Name: Fraud Detection ML Platform
Results.Description: Build an end-to-end machine learning platform for real-time fraud detection, including model training, scoring, and A/B testing capabilities.

Results.Name: Transaction Monitoring System
Results.Description: Implement real-time transaction monitoring with velocity checks, anomaly detection, and automated alerting for suspicious activity.

Results.Name: AML Compliance Engine
Results.Description: Develop an anti-money laundering pattern detection engine with automated SAR/CTR filing and regulatory reporting workflows.

Results.Name: ML Fraud Scoring Engine
Results.Description: Core fraud scoring engine using gradient boosted models with real-time feature extraction and model versioning. Serves predictions via gRPC with sub-50ms p99 latency.

Results.Name: Real-time Transaction Monitoring
Results.Description: Transaction velocity monitoring system with configurable threshold rules and anomaly detection alerting via Kafka streams.

Results.Name: AML Pattern Detection
Results.Description: Rule-based AML engine for detecting structuring, layering, and integration patterns with automated suspicious activity report generation.

Results.Name: Fraud score threshold calibration for card-not-present transactions
Results.Description: Calibrate fraud scoring thresholds specifically for CNP transactions using historical chargeback data. Threshold must balance false positive rate below 2% with detection rate above 95%.

Results.Name: Kafka consumer group rebalance handling for transaction monitor
Results.Description: Ensure the transaction monitoring Kafka consumer handles partition rebalances gracefully without dropping in-flight velocity window calculations.

Results.Name: Customer Identity Verification Platform
Results.Description: Build a KYC/KYB identity verification platform with document verification, biometric matching, and sanctions screening for onboarding and ongoing due diligence.

Results.Name: KYC Document Verification
Results.Description: Automated document verification pipeline for KYC compliance. Supports passport, driver's license, and national ID with OCR extraction and liveness detection.

Results.Name: Fraud Case Management
Results.Description: Unified case management system for fraud analysts with automated case routing, evidence aggregation, and disposition workflows.

Results.Name: Implement document OCR extraction pipeline
Results.Description: Build OCR extraction pipeline using Tesseract for passport, driver's license, and national ID documents. Must achieve 98%+ accuracy on MRZ zones and text fields.

Results.Name: Build liveness detection module for selfie verification
Results.Description: Integrate AWS Rekognition for liveness detection during selfie verification step. Must detect photo/video replay attacks with 99%+ accuracy.

Results.Name: Create case routing engine with priority scoring
Results.Description: Build automated case routing engine that assigns fraud cases to analysts based on priority score, analyst expertise, and current workload. Priority scoring uses risk level, amount, and detection confidence.

Results.Name: Build evidence aggregation from multiple detection sources
Results.Description: Aggregate fraud evidence from velocity monitor, anomaly detector, and AML engine into unified case evidence timeline for analyst review.

Results.Name: ML model false positive rate spike after retraining on Q3 data
Results.Description: After retraining the XGBoost fraud scoring model on Q3 2026 data, the false positive rate for card-not-present transactions increased from 1.8% to 4.2%, exceeding the 2% SLO threshold. Root cause suspected to be feature distribution drift in transaction metadata.

Results.Name: Kafka consumer lag causing delayed velocity alerts
Results.Description: Transaction velocity monitor consumer group experiencing persistent lag of 5000+ messages during peak hours (11am-2pm EST), causing alerts to fire 3-5 minutes late. Fixed by increasing partition count and consumer instances.
